verdicts.reason: A reverses the message to 'MAKEUP TRAVEL', and 'KIT' has lost its white box: it sits clipped, black-on-dark over the busy brush photo and is almost unreadable. B keeps the reading order TRAVEL, MAKEUP, KIT, but its white bars run into each other and look misaligned (MAKEUP is pushed against the right of its bar), 'KIT' also floats boxless on the image with poor contrast, and the tiny text and cropped photo make it look like a squashed strip, not a redesigned banner.
